Fallout4.ccc not found.
CC files may not be detected. Verifying Steam files or reinstalling should fix this.

formats.tooltip:
General/GNRL/Main: Used for all non-texture files.
Hard limit of 256, after which the game will crash at the main menu.

Texture/DX10: Used only for textures.
No hard limit, but functional limit is 255, after which the game fails
to use correct textures.
1.11.240 has increased this limit to 1024.

unreadable.tooltip: Files that could not be read due to permissions, unexpected format, or corruption.

versions.tooltip:
v1 works with all FO4 versions.
v7/v8 require either BASS or NG.
Some apps only support v1.

hedr100.tooltip:
Plugin header v1.00 has a larger Form ID range.
Any plugins with IDs below 800 MUST be v1.00.
FO4VR only supports v0.95.

hedr95.tooltip:
Plugin header v0.95 has a smaller Form ID range.
Any plugins with IDs below 800 MUST be v1.00.
FO4VR only supports v0.95.

In the base game, these 4 modules are v0.95:
• DLCCoast.esm
• DLCworkshop02.esm
• DLCworkshop03.esm
• DLCNukaWorld.esm

hedrUnknown.tooltip:
These modules have an unsupported header version.
Fallout 4 supports only v0.95 and v1.00.

Files with v0.94 were likey made with FalloutSnip and
should be replaced, recreated, or removed.
Use such mods AT YOUR OWN RISK as they may result
in unknown behavior or issues due to having an invalid
structure or corruption.

limits.tooltip:
Full modules include all non-Light modules.
Light modules are ESL-flagged and/or have the .esl extension.

Light modules give up the capacity to contain more than 4096
new records in exchange for having a higher plugin limit.

types.tooltip:
Full modules include all non-Light modules.
Light modules are ESL-flagged and/or have the .esl extension.

Light modules give up the capacity to contain more than 4096
new records in exchange for having a higher plugin limit.

unreadable.tooltip: Files that could not be read due to permissions, unexpected format, or corruption.

problems.solution: Your mod manager must launch the app to be detected.

Verify files with Steam or reinstall the game.
If you downgraded the game you will need to do so again afterward.
problems.summary:
The CC list file was not found in your game install path.
This is used to detect which CC modules/archives may be enabled.

problems.solution:
It may be possible to open/resave this file with Creation Kit to update its format for Fallout 4.
You should compare the original and resaved files with xEdit to verify no undesired changes were made.
problems.summary:
Module version (0.94) is not valid for Fallout 4.
Games supporting v0.94: Skyrim LE, Skyrim VR, Skyrim SE, Fallout 3, Fallout NV

problems.solution:
Fallout4.ini may be damaged or incomplete. Restore it from a backup,
or rename it and launch the game once with its launcher to generate a new one.
problems.summary:
No [Archive] section was found in Fallout4.ini or Fallout4Custom.ini, so the archives it lists can't be detected.
Archive counts may be lower than your actual counts.
